headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: Yield (%) 2.69 Shareholding (%) Promoters 32.50 FII’s DII’s 23.46 22.26 Public Government 11.78 10.00 TOTAL 100.0 Price chart 0 5000 10000 15000 20000 25000 30000 0 500 1000 1500 2000 2500 Apr-2023 Oct-2023 Apr-2024 Oct-2024 Apr-2025 Oct-2025 Apr-2026 Oct-2026 MGL Nifty MGL reported net revenue of ₹2,537 crore in Q2 FY27, up 7.0% QoQ and ~23.7% YoY, supported by higher realizations and healthy volume growth.
EBITDA declined 11.1% QoQ to ₹305 crore, with EBITDA margin contracting to 12.0% from 14.5% in Q1 FY27 due to elevated gas procurement costs.
EBITDA/scm declined to ₹6.77 from ₹7.91, while PAT fell 29.3% QoQ to ₹137 crore, with PAT margin at 5.4%.
MGL continued expanding its distribution network, adding 70,501 domestic PNG conversions during the quarter under PNG Drive 3.0.
valuation: Valuation call: We recommend a Buy with a price target of INR 1,430 (10.8X P/E FY29) from the CMP of INR 1,108 representing an upside of 29% over the next 24 months.
watch: Management maintained its medium-term volume growth outlook of 8–9%, supported by healthy CNG and domestic PNG demand.
Management highlighted continued RLNG supply restrictions and elevated gas prices as key challenges.
